description: Check whether a domain's TLS is using post-quantum (hybrid ML-KEM) key exchange. Verdicts come from the open-source FEDLIN PQC Toolkit's published ruleset, under the civilian (NIST) or nss (CNSA 2.0) profile.

domain.description: A bare public hostname to scan, for example example.com. No scheme, path, or port; IP literals and internal hostnames are rejected.

profile.description: Verdict profile: civilian (NIST FIPS 203/204/205 and IR 8547, the default) or nss (national security systems, CNSA 2.0).

name: scan_post_quantum
